opening_message:
Ticket 1: Timothy Wallace (employee ID E022) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E022.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Timothy Wallace (E022) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin on Payroll. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so as an Engineer admin is not permitted; maximum for full-time employees is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Timothy Wallace (E022) is a contractor with basic security training (note in memory says full-time, but DB is authoritative). Contractors with basic training are limited to read; they never get admin. Requested admin exceeds maximum, so recommend read.
reason: Timothy Wallace (E022) requested admin access to Payroll. According to the Security DB (authoritative per Note 2), Timothy is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors with basic training are limited to read and never receive admin, so the maximum permitted access is read. Since the requested admin level exceeds the maximum, I grant the maximum: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Timothy Wallace (E022)
Requested: admin access to Payroll

Two notes in memory:
- Note 1: role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Says full-time Engineer requesting admin on Payroll; Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role; admin not permitted for Engineer; max for full-time is write.
- Note 2: role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Says Security DB shows contractor with basic training; limited to read; never admin.

There's a conflict: one note says full-time, one says contractor. Note 2 claims Security DB is authoritative. So employee is contractor with basic training.

Policy for contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. With basic training, max is read.

Requested admin > max read, so grant maximum = read.

I'll submit read with reasoning.
